scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm audit --audit-level=moderate && npm run build
scripts.security:check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run security:audit

_comments.verify: Full CI/CD gate: lint → typecheck → test with coverage thresholds → audit → build
_comments.security:audit: Run standalone to check for known CVEs in dependencies
_comments.test:coverage: Fails if coverage drops below thresholds set in vite.config.ts
